entries.title: Psalms 21:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The king shall have joy in Your strength, O LORD; And in Your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

entries.title: Psalms 21:2
segments: You have given him his heart's desire, And have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 21:3
segments: For You meet him with the blessings of goodness; You set a crown of pure gold upon his head.

entries.title: Psalms 21:4
segments: He asked life from You, [and] You gave [it] to him-Length of days forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 21:5
segments: His glory [is] great in Your salvation; Honor and majesty You have placed upon him.

entries.title: Psalms 21:6
segments: For You have made him most blessed forever; You have made him exceedingly glad with Your presence.

entries.title: Psalms 21:7
segments: ¶For the king trusts in the LORD, And through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 21:8
segments: Your hand will find all Your enemies; Your right hand will find those who hate You.

entries.title: Psalms 21:9
segments: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of Your anger; The LORD shall swallow them up in His wrath, And the fire shall devour them.

entries.title: Psalms 21:10
segments: Their offspring You shall destroy from the earth, And their descendants from among the sons of men.

entries.title: Psalms 21:11
segments: For they intended evil against You; They devised a plot [which] they are not able [to perform].

entries.title: Psalms 21:12
segments: Therefore You will make them turn their back; You will make ready [Your arrows] on Your string toward their faces.

entries.title: Psalms 21:13
segments: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your own strength! We will sing and praise Your power.
